# Environmental DNA Analysis

These are the scripts for the analys of the eDNA result the raw results were processed into the microeco (S6) class data frame using the script shared in the line xxxx

```{r cars}
pacman::p_load(
  microeco,
  phyloseq
)

df_micrltr <- readRDS("data/df_microeco_2.rds")

# Remove OTUs with fewer than 20 contigs
df_divstat <- clone(df_microeco)

df_divstat$sample_table <- subset(
  df_divstat$sample_table,
  system == "Mangrove"
)

df_divstat$filter_taxa(
  rel_abund = 0.00000102,
  freq = 1
)
df_divstat$tidy_dataset()

# Remove "Unexpected" and none marine taxa
df_marine <- clone(df_divstat)

df_marine$tax_table <- subset(df_marine$tax_table,
                                Habitat != "Terrestrial" &
                                  Habitat != "Freshwater" &
                                status == "Expected")

# Clean and remove the filtered metadata
df_marine$tidy_dataset()

otu_data <- df_marine$tax_table

# Load library
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

# Summaries unique counts per kingdom
df_summary <- otu_data |> 
  group_by(kingdom) |> 
  summarise(
    Unique_Phylum  = n_distinct(phylum),
    Unique_Class   = n_distinct(class),
    Unique_Order   = n_distinct(order),
    Unique_Family  = n_distinct(family),
    Unique_Genus   = n_distinct(genus),
    Unique_Species = n_distinct(scientific_name)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

# Add total row
df_totals <- df_summary |> 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) |> 
  mutate(kingdom = "Total")

# Bind totals to summary
df_final_summary <- bind_rows(df_summary, df_totals)
```

## Including Plots
